answer: Tie finality to K independent attestations instead of one signature. A submission seals only after K distinct established peers—each carrying its own hard-won standing—sign off, the way a copper plate shows an image only once separate layers of pigment are pressed in, or a lotus opens only when every petal has cleared the water. A lone actor cannot self-finalize: to forge one sealed record a Sybil must separately establish and keep honest K real identities. Set K=7 and 7 independent multi-epoch work-streams are required per fake, linear real cost with no shared seal to amortize.
